meta.name: gmail
meta.description: This skill should be used when searching, fetching, or downloading emails from Gmail. Use for queries like "search Gmail for...", "find emails from John", "show unread emails", "emails about project X", or "download attachment from email".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从Gmail中搜索、获取或下载邮件
copy.tagline_en: Search, fetch, and download emails from Gmail
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to search, fetch, or download emails from Gmail

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以搜索、获取和下载 Gmail 中的邮件。它能按关键词、发件人、标签、日期等条件筛选，并返回邮件摘要或完整内容。
howto.when: 当你要求搜索 Gmail 邮件、查找特定发件人的邮件、显示未读邮件、下载附件或查询邮件标签时触发。

say.text: 搜索 Gmail 中关于项目 deadline 的邮件
查找来自 boss@company.com 的未读邮件
say.note: 筛选出发件人为 boss 的未读邮件

say.text: 下载邮件 ID 为 18abc123def 的附件
say.note: 将附件保存到默认下载目录

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can search, fetch, and download emails from Gmail. It can filter by keywords, sender, label, date, etc., and return snippets or full content.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to search Gmail, find emails from a specific sender, show unread emails, download attachments, or query email labels.

say_en.text: Search Gmail for emails about project deadline

say_en.note: Saves attachments to default download folder
